idea-plugin.name: Smart Changes
idea-plugin.description:
Smart Changes adds a focused view of local changes to the Commit tool window in WebStorm, helping you navigate large change sets and prepare commits.

  • Sort files by name, type, path, or modification time, and optionally group them by file extension.
  • Hide unrelated files from the main list, then review or restore them in a separate hidden view. Hidden paths and view preferences are saved per project.
  • See separate Staged and Unstaged rows when a Git file has changes in both areas. Use checkboxes to stage or unstage changes through the IDE's native Git actions.
  • Open diffs, copy file paths, and access native VCS context actions with familiar file icons and status colors.
  • Write a commit message and start the native Commit or Commit and Push workflow from the same panel.

The view refreshes automatically as VCS changes are reported. Git staging support follows the IDE's staging-area setting; standard VCS change lists remain available when staging is disabled.

Hiding files only affects the Smart Changes view: it does not modify files or change their staging state. If hidden files are already staged, Smart Changes warns you before opening the native commit workflow.
